mapper.delete: delete from news where news_id=#{userId} and (news_senderid=#{chatId} or news_recipienterid=#{chatId}) and source=#{source}
mapper.update: update news set news_content=#{newsContent}, news_time=#{newsTime}, news_senderid=#{newsSenderid}, news_recipienterid=#{newsRecipienterid}, news_type=#{newsType} where news_id=#{newsId}
